opportunities.name: Serenity damage medic
opportunities.objective: Test serenity damage medic against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Serenity WW grants an AP-scaled ally shield over time; Helia stores charges from champion damage, then shielding consumes them as healing. EQ/EW/EE immobilization fits Mandate's current vulnerability text, while WE restores mana for damage-to-shield cycles.
opportunities.requiredState: An ally remains in WW and Hwei lands distinct damaging spells.
opportunities.failure: Weak burst and shielding reduction make the utility investment poor.
opportunities.test: Measure Helia charge spending and allied shielding per WW cast.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: WE's self mana restoration is not an allied heal; Mandate no longer follows every slow in this catalog.

opportunities.name: Three-lights attack mage
opportunities.objective: Test three-lights attack mage against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: WE explicitly empowers three abilities or attacks for 0.15 AP bonus magic damage and restores mana each time; Nashor and Dusk and Dawn test spending lights through attacks between E setup and Q. Seraph is earned through Archangel and supplies a defensive mana ceiling.
opportunities.requiredState: WE active with a controlled target inside attack range.
opportunities.failure: Basic attacks expose Hwei and spending lights on them delays safer spell pressure.
opportunities.test: Compare three light attacks against light-empowered spell expenditure.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Three WE attack hits do not replace the passive's requirement for a second damaging ability.

ruledOut.reason: WE's self mana restoration is not an allied heal; Mandate no longer follows every slow in this catalog.

unknowns: Controlled current-patch proc testing remains necessary; source helper/statFormula expressions are evidence, not confirmed runtime behavior.

builds.name: Serenity damage medic
builds.summary: Test serenity damage medic against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test serenity damage medic against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Serenity WW grants an AP-scaled ally shield over time; Helia stores charges from champion damage, then shielding consumes them as healing. EQ/EW/EE immobilization fits Mandate's current vulnerability text, while WE restores mana for damage-to-shield cycles.
testPlan: Required state: An ally remains in WW and Hwei lands distinct damaging spells.
Measure Helia charge spending and allied shielding per WW cast.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Weak burst and shielding reduction make the utility investment poor.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: WE's self mana restoration is not an allied heal; Mandate no longer follows every slow in this catalog.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Echoes of Helia, Moonstone Renewer, Ardent Censer, Dawncore, Imperial Mandate, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
builds.author: ChatGPT

kitEvidence.formula:
Hwei's damaging Abilities against enemy champions mark them for [4] seconds.

Hitting marked enemies with a second damaging Ability creates an explosion underneath them dealing [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 285; raw flags preserved) + (0.35) × AP] magic damage to all enemies in range.
